name: done-chime
description: Plays a chime and shows a toast when Claude finishes a long job, so you can walk away from the screen.

min_seconds.title: Minimum seconds
min_seconds.description: Only chime when a job ran at least this many seconds.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Chime volume, from 0 (silent) to 4 (loud). 1 is normal.
